Reservering av bilplats och fraktleveranser via bokningssystemet tidigast två veckor innan avgång.
Fordonen och passagerare bör vara klara för inlastning 10 min. före avgångstiden.
Fartygens max antal passagerarmängd 73, max lastkapacitet 60t, max antal personbilar 13.
Beroende på omständigheterna kan turlistan ändras eller trafiken inställas.

Autopaikan ja rahdin varaus maksimissaan kaksi viikkoa ennen aiottua lähtöä tilausjärjestelmän kautta.
Ajoneuvojen ja matkustajien tulee olla lastausvalmiina 10 min ennen lähtöaikaa.
Aluksen max. matkustajamäärä 73, max. lastikapasiteetti 60t, henkilöautomäärä 13.
Olosuhteista johtuen voidaan aikataulusta poiketa tai liikenne keskeyttää.

Reservations of deck space for vehicle and cargo transport via the booking system at the earliest two weeks before desired departure.
Vehicles and passengers must be ready for loading 10 min before departure time.
Max. amount of passengers 73, max. carrying capacity 60t, max. amount of cars 13.
Due to circumstances there can be changes in the schedule or tours can be cancelled.

parenthesizedPensarTime.interpretation: Pensar is the farthest point of the route. The printed time gives passengers a useful estimate and may normally be fairly stable, including for passengers boarding at subsequent stops, but it is not guaranteed to the minute.

booking.interpretation: Every passenger journey must be booked. This general rule is distinct from whether an individual route deviation needs a separate call order.

deadlineRules.sourceAmbiguity: The source says 'morning tour'; this is interpreted as only the first departure of the day.

Granholmen.availableJourneys: Granvik-Granholmen and Granholmen-Granvik on all services unless excluded below
Granholmen.structuralExpansion: Treat Granholmen as an omitted timetable row adjacent to every Heisala call, before or after Heisala according to the direction of travel.
Granholmen.routeContext: Granvik-Heisala is nearly a shuttle service and Granholmen is only a small deviation. Granholmen was omitted as a repeated timetable row for readability.

userNotice.en: bookable only when circumstances require it

retiredStops.evidence: The stop appeared in at least the 2019 timetable but not in the checked 2025 summer timetables or the current 2026-2027 winter timetable.
